description: Source code for managing PUCCH (Physical Uplink Control Channel) resources in a 5G NR scheduler, including resource reservation, release, and collision management.

classes.name: pucch_resource_manager
classes.description: Manages PUCCH resource allocation, deallocation, and collision detection for a cell.

classes.name: pucch_resource_manager::ue_reservation_guard
classes.description: Handles reservation, release, and commit of PUCCH resources for a specific UE.

methods.name: get_csi_res_id
methods.description: Retrieves the CSI-specific PUCCH resource ID from UE cell configuration.

methods.name: pucch_resource_manager::pucch_resource_manager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the resource manager with cell configuration.

methods.name: pucch_resource_manager::slot_indication
methods.description: Updates internal state for a new slot and clears previous slot context.

methods.name: pucch_resource_manager::stop
methods.description: Resets all slot contexts and stops collision management.

methods.name: pucch_resource_manager::reserve_harq_common_resource
methods.description: Reserves a common HARQ resource for uplink transmission.

methods.name: pucch_resource_manager::release_harq_common_resource
methods.description: Releases a previously reserved common HARQ resource.

methods.name: pucch_resource_manager::ue_reservation_guard::reserve_harq_set_0_resource_next_available
methods.description: Reserves the next available HARQ set 0 resource for a UE.

methods.name: pucch_resource_manager::ue_reservation_guard::reserve_harq_set_1_resource_next_available
methods.description: Reserves the next available HARQ set 1 resource for a UE.

methods.name: pucch_resource_manager::ue_reservation_guard::reserve_harq_set_0_resource_by_res_indicator
methods.description: Reserves HARQ set 0 resource by resource indicator.

methods.name: pucch_resource_manager::ue_reservation_guard::reserve_harq_set_1_resource_by_res_indicator
methods.description: Reserves HARQ set 1 resource by resource indicator.

methods.name: pucch_resource_manager::ue_reservation_guard::reserve_sr_resource
methods.description: Reserves a Scheduling Request (SR) resource for a UE.

methods.name: pucch_resource_manager::ue_reservation_guard::reserve_csi_resource
methods.description: Reserves a CSI-specific PUCCH resource for a UE.

methods.name: pucch_resource_manager::ue_reservation_guard::peek_sr_resource
methods.description: Returns the SR resource without reserving it.

methods.name: pucch_resource_manager::ue_reservation_guard::peek_csi_resource
methods.description: Returns the CSI resource without reserving it.

methods.name: pucch_resource_manager::ue_reservation_guard::release_harq_set_0_resource
methods.description: Releases HARQ set 0 resource.

methods.name: pucch_resource_manager::ue_reservation_guard::release_harq_set_1_resource
methods.description: Releases HARQ set 1 resource.

methods.name: pucch_resource_manager::ue_reservation_guard::release_sr_resource
methods.description: Releases SR resource.

methods.name: pucch_resource_manager::ue_reservation_guard::release_csi_resource
methods.description: Releases CSI resource.

methods.name: pucch_resource_manager::ue_reservation_guard::reserve_next_harq_res_available
methods.description: Reserves the next available HARQ resource in a set.

methods.name: pucch_resource_manager::ue_reservation_guard::reserve_harq_resource_by_res_indicator
methods.description: Reserves HARQ resource by resource indicator.

methods.name: pucch_resource_manager::ue_reservation_guard::release_harq_resource
methods.description: Releases a specific HARQ resource in a set.

methods.name: pucch_resource_manager::ue_reservation_guard::get_res_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves a PUCCH resource by its ID.

methods.name: pucch_resource_manager::ue_reservation_guard::commit
methods.description: Commits the current reservations, releasing unnecessary resources.

methods.name: pucch_resource_manager::ue_reservation_guard::rollback
methods.description: Reverts all reservations made in the current guard.
